question_text: Which demo booth attracted bigger crowds — NVIDIA or Intel? Roughly how much more popular was the winner?
answer_text: NVIDIA attracted bigger crowds. From 2025-12-08T00:00:00Z to 2025-12-09T00:00:00Z, its weighted average headcount was 15.515 vs Intel’s 10.648333333333333 — about 1.457035529816873× higher (a +4.866666666666667 difference), with peaks of 86 vs 53.

citations.cypher:
WITH '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AS W_start, '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' AS W_end
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= W_start AND ch.hour_utc < W_end
  AND (toLower(ch.camera_location) CONTAINS 'nvidia' OR toLower(ch.camera_location) CONTAINS 'intel')
WITH CASE
       WHEN toLower(ch.camera_location) CONTAINS 'nvidia' THEN 'NVIDIA'
       WHEN toLower(ch.camera_location) CONTAINS 'intel' THEN 'Intel'
     END AS booth, ch, W_start, W_end
WITH booth,
     sum(coalesce(ch.event_count,0)) AS samples,
     sum(coalesce(ch.avg_hc,0.0) * coalesce(ch.event_count,0)) AS person_seconds,
     max(coalesce(ch.peak_hc,0.0)) AS peak_hc,
     W_start, W_end
WITH collect({
  booth: booth,
  samples: samples,
  person_seconds: person_seconds,
  peak_hc: peak_hc,
  weighted_avg: CASE WHEN samples > 0 THEN person_seconds / samples ELSE 0.0 END
}) AS booths, W_start, W_end
WITH
  [b IN booths WHERE b.booth = 'NVIDIA'][0] AS n,
  [b IN booths WHERE b.booth = 'Intel'][0] AS i,
  W_start, W_end
WITH
  coalesce(n.weighted_avg, 0.0) AS n_avg,
  coalesce(i.weighted_avg, 0.0) AS i_avg,
  coalesce(n.peak_hc, 0.0) AS n_peak,
  coalesce(i.peak_hc, 0.0) AS i_peak,
  coalesce(n.samples, 0) AS n_samples,
  coalesce(i.samples, 0) AS i_samples,
  coalesce(n.person_seconds, 0.0) AS n_ps,
  coalesce(i.person_seconds, 0.0) AS i_ps,
  W_start, W_end
WITH
  CASE WHEN n_avg >= i_avg THEN 'NVIDIA' ELSE 'Intel' END AS winner,
  n_avg, i_avg, n_peak, i_peak, n_samples, i_samples, n_ps, i_ps, W_start, W_end
WITH winner,
     CASE WHEN winner = 'NVIDIA' THEN n_avg ELSE i_avg END AS winner_weighted_avg_hc,
     CASE WHEN winner = 'NVIDIA' THEN i_avg ELSE n_avg END AS loser_weighted_avg_hc,
     CASE WHEN winner = 'NVIDIA' THEN n_peak ELSE i_peak END AS winner_peak_hc,
     CASE WHEN winner = 'NVIDIA' THEN i_peak ELSE n_peak END AS loser_peak_hc,
     CASE WHEN winner = 'NVIDIA' THEN n_samples ELSE i_samples END AS winner_samples,
     CASE WHEN winner = 'NVIDIA' THEN i_samples ELSE n_samples END AS loser_samples,
     CASE WHEN winner = 'NVIDIA' THEN n_ps ELSE i_ps END AS winner_person_seconds,
     CASE WHEN winner = 'NVIDIA' THEN i_ps ELSE n_ps END AS loser_person_seconds,
     W_start, W_end
RETURN winner,
       winner_weighted_avg_hc,
       loser_weighted_avg_hc,
       CASE WHEN loser_weighted_avg_hc = 0 THEN null ELSE winner_weighted_avg_hc / loser_weighted_avg_hc END AS popularity_ratio,
       (winner_weighted_avg_hc - loser_weighted_avg_hc) AS popularity_diff_hc,
       winner_peak_hc,
       loser_peak_hc,
       winner_person_seconds,
       loser_person_seconds,
       winner_samples,
       loser_samples,
       W_start AS window_start_utc,
       W_end AS window_end_utc
